name: Mega-NeRF-Dynamic Rendering
definition: An interactive rendering method that exploits temporal coherence in fly-throughs by dynamically expanding and reusing a sparse voxel octree cache across frames.
summary: Mega-NeRF-Dynamic Rendering is an interactive large-scale NeRF method that reduces latency by dynamically expanding a sparse voxel octree cache across frames to enable higher resolution than fixed precomputed approaches.
